history.summary: This is a 2BR at The Arcady at Boon Keng (D12, FH, 172 units, TOP Dec 2028) — a small new-launch project — listed at $1.945M / a steep $2,869 PSF for just 678sqft. The 'Cheap Freehold condo' title is misleading: this is near-peak new-launch pricing in a small development, the opposite of cheap.
history.rating_rationale: Confirmed as The Arcady at Boon Keng (KSH/SLB/Ho Lee, 172 units, FH, TOP 2028). $2,869 PSF is well above the project's ~$24xx launch average, so this resale/sub-sale ask is over-priced even for a new launch. Only 172 units = shallow liquidity; new-launch buyers pay a developer premium that compresses 5-7yr resale upside; and a $1.95M 2BR shoebox-ish 678sqft at near-$2,900 PSF is squarely the inflated entry the rubric says to avoid.
red_flags: $2,869 PSF is above The Arcady's ~$24xx launch average — over-priced
Only 172 units — shallow liquidity and limited amenities
New-launch developer-premium pricing compresses 5-7yr resale upside; misleading 'cheap' title
catalysts: Freehold tenure near Boon Keng MRT (510m), city-fringe D12
1km to St Andrew's Junior / Hong Wen schools
